every-blocking-gap-decided.reason: Both blocking gaps are now decided by the PM: QST-0005 -> DEC-0004 (research capability as a typed extension interface) and QST-0006 -> DEC-0005 (tier 1 first, behind a typed validation controller with a stated boundary). QST-0007, QST-0008 and QST-0010 remain open and are not blocking under DEC-0002 — no current commitment's correctness depends on them and none makes this criterion unevaluable. Implementing the extension, the first research adapter and the tier-1 controller is work, not a gap.
